title: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students
question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, and the department is either Chemistry or Biology, provide the department, academic year, count of subjects, minimum start date of the term, term description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and departments that are degree granting, but excluding the Chemistry department), along with the school name and the department phone number, listing the columns in this order: department, academic year, subject count, minimum term start date, term description, average total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, school name, and department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH enrolled AS (
  SELECT
    s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count,
    MIN(t.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date,
    t.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
    AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
  GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION
),
unit_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,
    AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units,
    STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
    AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'
  GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
)
SELECT
  e.department AS department,
  e.academic_year AS academic_year,
  e.subject_count AS subject_count,
  e.min_term_start_date AS min_term_start_date,
  e.term_description AS term_description,
  us.avg_total_units AS avg_total_units,
  us.stddev_total_units AS stddev_total_units,
  sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone_number
FROM enrolled AS e
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON e.department = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
LEFT JOIN unit_stats AS us ON e.department = us.department AND e.academic_year = us.academic_year
LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE

  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,

  AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0

  AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry'
